_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE monthly prices in GBP, eu-west-1, on-demand, 730 hours.
These are the right ORDER OF MAGNITUDE and the right RANKING, which is what a cost
review needs. They are not quotes — check current pricing before you commit to anything,
and use Infracost or the AWS Pricing Calculator when the number has to be defensible.
Kept as data rather than hardcoded in the script so you can correct it for your region.
